authentication.login_flow: POST /api/v1/auth/login → sets httponly v5d_session cookie + returns Bearer token
authentication.session_store: In-memory dict (SESSIONS = {}) — NOT Redis, lost on restart

session_cookie.name: v5d_session
session_cookie.note: secure=False must be True in production with HTTPS

authentication.token_format: UUID v4 — not JWT, no cryptographic signature

role_model.current_implementation: owner auto-assigned on workspace create, admin on project create

permission_check.tenant_isolation: All queries filter by tenant_id from session
permission_check.workspace_access: Not explicitly checked beyond tenant isolation
permission_check.project_access: Not explicitly checked beyond tenant isolation

authorization.api_authorization: get_current_user() extracts user_id + tenant_id from cookie/header — no role checking

cors_policy.risk: Open CORS in production — should be restricted to known origins

security_headers.note: Security headers in production.py are defined but NOT verified as applied to API responses

secret_handling.api_key_storage: AES-256-GCM encrypted, tenant-scoped, stored in encrypted_credentials table
secret_handling.api_key_retrieval: Decrypted server-side at test time, immediately zeroed after use
secret_handling.secret_scanning: Patterns for openai_key, anthropic_key, bearer_token, json_api_key
